identifiers.identifier_scope: Investigational development code; no verified public registry identifiers confidently attributable from established human clinical or regulatory sources.

modality: Small molecule (investigational code; exact modality not fully verified in authoritative public clinical/regulatory sources)

typical_use.scope: Publicly verifiable clinical use not established.

data_notes.record_scope: No robust, publicly verifiable evidence was identified establishing 3SC009 as an approved drug or as a human clinical-stage oncology agent with extractable clinical pharmacology metrics. Record therefore reflects absence of confirmed data rather than inferred properties.
data_notes.mechanism_doi_meaning: DOIs are listed only when directly supporting a stated mechanism or adverse-effect mechanism.
data_notes.empty_mechanism_doi_meaning: Empty DOI arrays indicate no directly verified DOI was identified for that field.
data_notes.null_meaning: Null indicates a specific datum was not confidently documented in accessible authoritative sources; empty arrays indicate no verified items identified.
